question.problem: Let $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}$ be a basis of ${R}^{3}$ and $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -8 \\ 3\end{aligned}].$ What are the coordinates of $x$ relative to the basis $C=\{{c}_{1},{c}_{2},{c}_{3}\},$ where ${c}_{1}=\frac{3}{4}{b}_{3}$, ${c}_{2}=-\frac{1}{3}{b}_{1}$ and ${c}_{3}=4{b}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
Since $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -8 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$, we can write $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =2{b}_{1}-8{b}_{2}+3{b}_{3} \\  & =3{b}_{3}+2{b}_{1}-8{b}_{2} \\  & =3\cdot \frac{4}{3}(\frac{3}{4}{b}_{3})-2\cdot 3(-\frac{1}{3}{b}_{1})-2(4{b}_{2}) \\  & =4{c}_{1}-6{c}_{2}-2{c}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -6 \\ -2\end{aligned}].$
